selection_rule: top-10 signatures per op by real-traffic call count, plus the smallest and largest input footprint, plus one signature per capture group; warmup-only signatures excluded

capture_modifiers: --disable-cuda-graph (python-level ops are invisible inside a captured graph)
tensors phase adds --disable-radix-cache (radix rewrites mamba/KDA state pool rows outside the kernel call and breaks the state chain)
workload_sources: sglang.bench_serving random 1024/256 cc16 for the profiled GPU-time share
